user.title: Set up TFA weatherhub
user.description: Data is uploaded by the weatherhub gateway to the Mobile Alerts cloud and fetched from there.

data_description.device_ids: 12-digit IDs of the transmitters (printed on the label or shown in the weatherhub app). Separate multiple IDs with commas or new lines.
data_description.scan_interval: Transmitters only send about every 7 minutes. The API allows at most 3 requests per minute.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the weatherhub server.
error.api_error: The weatherhub server returned an error (maybe rate limited – wait a moment).
error.invalid_device_id: Invalid device ID: {ids} (expected 12 hex characters, e.g. 0B1234567890).
error.no_device_ids: Please enter at least one device ID.
error.device_not_found: The server returns no data for: {ids}. Is the transmitter paired with the gateway?
